component.name: PodRacer
component.summary: Transfer music to an iPod from Linux, no iTunes

description.p: Midnight-commander-style two-pane UI: browse your music folder on the left, see what is on the iPod on the right. Manual sync, automatic duplicate avoidance, auto-transcode via ffmpeg. The classic iTunesDB family: iPod nano 1G-3G, classic 1G-5.5G, and mini.
